error.charge_limit_unknown: The car's charge limit is not known yet, so Charge on Solar cannot be set.
error.subscription_required: Subscription required. Please check your Teslemetry subscription.
error.vehicle_access_required: This vehicle no longer has Teslemetry access. Please check your Teslemetry subscription.
error.vehicle_telemetry_unavailable: Fleet Telemetry isn't configured for this vehicle.
error.vehicle_polling_mode: This vehicle is in legacy polling mode; live telemetry isn't available.
error.energy_site_access_required: This energy site no longer has Teslemetry access. Please check your Teslemetry subscription.
error.energy_site_feature_unsupported: This energy site's hardware doesn't support this feature.
error.could_not_wake_vehicle: Vehicle didn't wake up. Please try again.
error.insufficient_credits: Insufficient command credits. Please purchase additional credits to run commands.
error.device_removed: The selected device no longer exists. Please edit this Flow.
error.account_disconnected: Teslemetry account disconnected. Please re-authenticate to reconnect this device.
error.frunk_cannot_close: The frunk can't be closed remotely. Close it by hand.
error.energy_site_not_paired: Teslemetry is not paired with this Powerwall, so it cannot send this command. Pair it in the Teslemetry console, or turn on this Powerwall's local connection.
error.dispatch_out_of_range: The Powerwall refused this power: it is more than the Powerwall can charge or discharge. Try a lower power.
error.island_not_ready_for_islanding: The Powerwall refused: it is not ready to go off-grid right now. Try again later.
error.island_load_drop_expected: The Powerwall refused: the home is using more power than it can supply off-grid. Use less power and try again.
error.island_low_energy: The Powerwall refused: its charge is too low to go off-grid.
error.island_excessive_solar: The Powerwall refused: solar is producing more power than it can take off-grid. Try again when solar production is lower.

local_powerwall.approve: Flick the On/Off switch on your primary Powerwall off and back on to approve Homey, then save again. This is only needed once.
local_powerwall.host_not_found: Teslemetry could not find the gateway's address. Enter it, then save again.
local_powerwall.wrong_password: The gateway did not accept this password.
local_powerwall.gateway_unreachable: Homey could not reach the gateway. Check its address and that it is on the same network as Homey, then save again.
local_powerwall.cloud_unreachable: Tesla cannot reach your Powerwall right now. Try again later.
local_powerwall.preparing: Homey is preparing its key for your Powerwall. A notification will say when to approve it; then flick the On/Off switch on your primary Powerwall off and back on, and save again.
local_powerwall.key_ready: Homey's key is registered with your Powerwall. Flick the On/Off switch on your primary Powerwall off and back on, then save the Local connection settings again.
local_powerwall.registration_failed: Homey could not register its key with your Powerwall. Save the Local connection settings again to retry.
local_powerwall.needs_homey_pro: The local connection needs a Homey Pro on the same network as your Powerwall. Homey Cloud cannot reach your home network.

local_vehicle.tap_key_card: Homey is checking its key with the car. If the car asks for a key card, tap it on the center console.
local_vehicle.paired: __name__: Homey's key is on the car, so Homey can reach it over Bluetooth.
local_vehicle.not_found: __name__: Homey could not reach the car over Bluetooth. Park it close to Homey and turn Bluetooth on again.
local_vehicle.tap_timeout: __name__: No key card was tapped in time. Turn Bluetooth on again to retry.
local_vehicle.failed: __name__: The car did not add Homey's key. Turn Bluetooth on again to retry.
